SELECT SM.INVOICE_MONTH , D.DIVISION_NAME , C.CUSTOMER_NAME , SM.PRODUCT_CODE , IM.ITEM_NAME AS PRODUCT_NAME , IM.HS_CODE , SM.STATUS , GET_CODE_NAME(SM.STATUS::VARCHAR, 'DS', SM.COMPANY_CODE, 'KOR') AS STATUS_NAME , GET_CODE_NAME(SM.PRODUCT_ASSETS_TYPE, 'AT', SM.COMPANY_CODE, 'KOR') AS PRODUCT_ASSETS_TYPE_NAME , SM.COO_CERTIFY_NO FROM ( SELECT SM.COMPANY_CODE , SUBSTR(SM.INVOICE_DATE, 1, 6) AS INVOICE_MONTH , SD.DIVISION_CODE , SM.CUSTOMER_CODE , SD.PRODUCT_CODE , SUM(CASE WHEN SM.VIRTUAL_YN = 'Y' THEN SD.STATUS::INTEGER ELSE 0 END) AS STATUS , MAX(CASE WHEN SM.VIRTUAL_YN = 'Y' THEN SD.COO_CERTIFY_NO ELSE NULL END) AS COO_CERTIFY_NO , SD.PRODUCT_ASSETS_TYPE , SUM(SD.QUANTITY) AS QUANTITY FROM SALES_MST SM INNER JOIN SALES_DTL SD ON SM.COMPANY_CODE = SD.COMPANY_CODE AND SM.SALES_NO = SD.SALES_NO AND SM.DIVISION_CODE = SD.DIVISION_CODE INNER JOIN CUSTOMER C ON C.COMPANY_CODE = SD.COMPANY_CODE AND C.CUSTOMER_CODE = SD.DELIVERY_CUSTOMER_CODE LEFT JOIN CUSTOMER_MODEL CM ON CM.COMPANY_CODE = SD.COMPANY_CODE AND CM.DIVISION_CODE = SD.DIVISION_CODE AND CM.ITEM_CODE = SD.PRODUCT_CODE AND CM.CUSTOMER_CODE = SD.DELIVERY_CUSTOMER_CODE WHERE SM.COMPANY_CODE = #{company_code} AND SM.EXPORT_FLAG = 'D'
AND SM.INVOICE_DATE BETWEEN #{from_date} AND #{to_date}
GROUP BY SM.COMPANY_CODE , SUBSTR(SM.INVOICE_DATE, 1, 6) , SM.CUSTOMER_CODE , SD.DELIVERY_CUSTOMER_CODE , SD.DIVISION_CODE , SD.PRODUCT_CODE , SM.EXPORT_FLAG , SD.PROD_DIVISION_CODE , COALESCE(CM.CUSTOMER_ITEM_CODE, SD.CUSTOMER_ITEM_CODE) , SD.PRODUCT_ASSETS_TYPE ) SM INNER JOIN ITEM_MST IM ON IM.COMPANY_CODE = SM.COMPANY_CODE AND IM.ITEM_CODE = SM.PRODUCT_CODE LEFT JOIN DIVISION D ON D.COMPANY_CODE = SM.COMPANY_CODE AND D.DIVISION_CODE = SM.DIVISION_CODE INNER JOIN CUSTOMER C ON C.COMPANY_CODE = SM.COMPANY_CODE AND C.CUSTOMER_CODE = SM.CUSTOMER_CODE WHERE 1=1 AND SM.QUANTITY > 0 -- 반품 제외
AND D.DIVISION_CODE = #{division_code}
AND (C.CUSTOMER_CODE ILIKE '%' || #{customer} || '%' OR C.CUSTOMER_NAME ILIKE '%' || #{customer} || '%' )
AND (SM.PRODUCT_CODE ILIKE '%' || #{product} || '%' OR IM.ITEM_NAME ILIKE '%' || #{product} || '%' )
ORDER BY SM.INVOICE_MONTH, C.CUSTOMER_CODE, D.DIVISION_CODE, SM.PRODUCT_CODE

SELECT SM.INVOICE_DATE , D.DIVISION_NAME , C.CUSTOMER_NAME , SM.INVOICE_NO , SM.STATUS , GET_CODE_NAME(SM.STATUS, 'DS', SM.COMPANY_CODE, 'KOR') AS STATUS_NAME , GET_CODE_NAME(COALESCE(SM.ARRIVAL_NATION, C.NATION_CODE), 'NA', SM.COMPANY_CODE, 'KOR') AS EXPORT_NATION , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM FTA_APPLY_NATION FAN WHERE FAN.NATION_CODE = COALESCE(SM.ARRIVAL_NATION, C.NATION_CODE) AND FAN.EFFECT_DATE <= SM.INVOICE_DATE AND FM.FTA_CODE = FAN.FTA_CODE) AS FTA_CNT FROM ( SELECT SM.COMPANY_CODE , SM.SALES_NO , SM.DIVISION_CODE FROM SALES_MST SM INNER JOIN SALES_DTL SD ON SM.COMPANY_CODE = SD.COMPANY_CODE AND SM.SALES_NO = SD.SALES_NO AND SM.DIVISION_CODE = SD.DIVISION_CODE INNER JOIN ITEM_MST IM ON IM.COMPANY_CODE = SD.COMPANY_CODE AND IM.ITEM_CODE = SD.PRODUCT_CODE WHERE SM.COMPANY_CODE = #{company_code} AND SM.EXPORT_FLAG = 'E'
AND SM.INVOICE_DATE BETWEEN #{from_date} AND #{to_date}
AND (SM.PRODUCT_CODE ILIKE '%' || #{product} || '%' OR IM.ITEM_NAME ILIKE '%' || #{product} || '%' )
GROUP BY SM.COMPANY_CODE, SM.SALES_NO, SM.DIVISION_CODE ) SALES INNER JOIN SALES_MST SM ON SM.COMPANY_CODE = SALES.COMPANY_CODE AND SM.SALES_NO = SALES.SALES_NO AND SM.DIVISION_CODE = SALES.DIVISION_CODE LEFT JOIN DIVISION D ON D.COMPANY_CODE = SM.COMPANY_CODE AND D.DIVISION_CODE = SM.DIVISION_CODE INNER JOIN CUSTOMER C ON C.COMPANY_CODE = SM.COMPANY_CODE AND C.CUSTOMER_CODE = SM.CUSTOMER_CODE LEFT JOIN FTA_MASTER FM ON SM.COMPANY_CODE = FM.COMPANY_CODE AND SM.TARGET_FTA_CODE = FM.FTA_CODE AND FM.DELETE_YN = 'N' AND FM.FTA_STATUS = '4' WHERE 1=1
AND D.DIVISION_CODE = #{division_code}
AND (C.CUSTOMER_CODE ILIKE '%' || #{customer} || '%' OR C.CUSTOMER_NAME ILIKE '%' || #{customer} || '%' )
ORDER BY SM.INVOICE_DATE, C.CUSTOMER_CODE, D.DIVISION_CODE
